tokens.name: citrus
tokens.usage: Brand citrus: arrow badges, eyebrows and kickers, '+' list markers, card-hover borders, focus rings. 6.4:1 on ink; 2.9:1 on bone, so in the bone theme keep it to borders, badges, markers and hover states, never small copy.

tokens.name: citrus-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for citrus surfaces.

tokens.name: citrus-soft
tokens.usage: Soft citrus tint, defined in the site theme. Ink text on it is 16.4:1. Not used on the pages checked.

tokens.name: citrus-deep
tokens.usage: Deep citrus, defined in the site theme. 5.2:1 on bone and 5.5:1 on white, so it is the AA-safe citrus for small text on light grounds, where citrus itself is 2.9:1. Not used on the pages checked.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink. The site's ground and its dark text: page background in the ink theme, body text in the bone theme.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Ink 2. Hover fill for rows and cards on ink (service rows, resource rows).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Ink 3. Raised dark surfaces such as dropdown menus.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. Text and headings on ink; card fill in the bone theme.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Bone. Hero display type on ink, and the ground of light sections and pages.

tokens.name: bone-2
tokens.usage: Deeper bone for panels on bone, defined in the site theme. Ink text is 16.5:1; ink-muted is only 4.4:1, so use ink-muted on it for 18px+ only. Not used on the pages checked.

tokens.name: bone-muted
tokens.usage: Bone muted: the theme's solid muted color for text on ink, ink-2 and ink-3 (6.8:1 on ink), tuned for WCAG AA. Mono labels and breadcrumb slashes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Ink muted: the theme's solid muted color for text on white and bone (5.3:1 on white, 5.0:1 on bone), tuned for WCAG AA.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Silver: the cool orb light in IconGridBackground (home and interior variants) only. Not a UI or text color.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and section background. Ink is the default; bone for light sections and service pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and row fill. On ink, cards stay ink and are held by a border; on bone, cards are white.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for service rows and resource rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings, titles and primary text on bg and surface (19.8:1 on ink, 18.7:1 on bone).

tokens.name: fg-display
tokens.usage: Hero display headlines: bone on ink, ink on bone.

tokens.name: fg-body
tokens.usage: List items and hero intro copy on bg (14.2:1 on ink, 10.7:1 on bone).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs and descriptions on bg and surface (8.4:1 on ink, 6.2:1 on bone).

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text such as authors and dates, and 'View all' links at rest (about 6.3:1 on ink, 5.1:1 on bone).

tokens.name: fg-label
tokens.usage: Mono labels (TOOL, ONGOING) and breadcrumb separators.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The only accent in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for citrus fills.

tokens.name: accent-on
tokens.usage: Arrow on a filled (hovered) arrow badge. White on citrus is 3.1:1, which holds for a 13px icon glyph, not for text.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Underline under 'Explore →' links at rest; goes to accent on hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, header and footer rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Column dividers in the hero, newsletter input border, pricing card border.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Pill button outline at rest; hover goes to fg. 2.1:1 on ink (the site's value is kept); the label and citrus badge carry the button's meaning.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Form field border at rest; also round icon buttons. 1.8:1 on ink (the site's value is kept); always pair a field with its visible mono label.

tokens.name: field-focus
tokens.usage: Form field border on focus.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields; decorative only.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Organic visibility for a changing search landscape.
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline in fg-display. Fluid clamp(56px, 7.8vw, 124px); always Light (the site pins the weight axis to 300); balanced wrap.

styles.name: display-cta
styles.usage: Closing CTA headline. 48px, then 72px at 768px, then 96px at 1024px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings with a 'View all →' link beside them. 60px at 1024px and up, 48px below. Tracking is the theme's letter-spacing-display (−0.025em).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Default h2: 30px, then 48px at 768px and up. Tracking is the theme's letter-spacing-display (−0.025em).

styles.name: h3-lg
styles.sample: Your site's staying. Let's make it earn more.
styles.usage: Service promise and card-link titles: 24px, then 36px at 768px. Tracking is the theme's letter-spacing-display (−0.025em).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card, resource and feature titles: 20px, then 24px at 768px. Tracking is the theme's letter-spacing-display (−0.025em).

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small sub-heads, names in team lists. Tracking is the theme's letter-spacing-display (−0.025em).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Before you can optimize effectively, you need to understand where you stand.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page hero, in fg-muted.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We take a practical approach combining deep analysis with clear priorities.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A full audit of the site you have today, delivered as a ranked action plan.
styles.usage: Body copy, in fg-muted on ink. In bone sections paragraphs render at 400.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Evaluate your information architecture for the machine readers that check your site.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation, in fg-muted and fg on hover.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Hero kicker above the display headline: citrus, uppercase. 14px on mobile.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows, service and category labels, field labels, 'Typically includes': uppercase mono, 0.18em (the theme's letter-spacing-eyebrow).

styles.name: eyebrow-sm
styles.usage: Timeline steps, card-link labels (TOOL, ONGOING), price notes; 0.18em.

styles.name: marker
styles.usage: The '+' before each 'Typically includes' item, in citrus.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale; names match the site's utility numbers (space-6 = px-6 = 24px).

tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Small pill button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Link-to-arrow gaps, pill vertical padding (large).

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: List item spacing in 'Typically includes'.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow-to-title gaps; small button gap.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Medium button label-to-badge gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-5

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile row padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Resource row padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Service row padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap inside service rows.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Heading-to-content gap on desktop; inner-page section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: space-28

tokens.name: space-40

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Closing CTA section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Newsletter email input (the only symmetric rounded corner besides pills).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The Sitelogic corner: applied to the TOP-RIGHT and BOTTOM-LEFT corners only (border-radius: 0 16px). Cards, resource lists, image frames, contact fields.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, arrow badges, round icon buttons.

shadow.note: The site is flat; the only shadow is on the header dropdown.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Header mega-menu dropdown.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding at 768px and up (24px below).

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page side padding on mobile.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content max width, centered.

tokens.name: section-pad
tokens.usage: Homepage section padding at 768px and up (96px below).
